map.园艺修剪时间提示 使用指南: Gardening Pruning Time Reminder User Guide
map.选择植物类型（月季、果树、灌木等）与季节，推荐最佳修剪时间窗口与操作要点，帮助花: Choose the plant type (rose, fruit tree, shrub etc.) and season to get the best pruning window and key operating points, keeping the garden shapely and flowering well. Used for home gardening scheduling.
map.按植物查询四季修剪适宜度（最适宜/可以/避免），避免在花芽分化期误剪导致来年无花: Query seasonal pruning suitability by plant (most suitable / acceptable / avoid) to prevent mistimed cuts during flower-bud differentiation that would mean no flowers the following year.
map.对照具体修剪时机（如月季早春萌芽前重剪、绣球 8 月底至 9 月修剪）安排养护日: Map the care schedule against the specific pruning timing (for example roses pruned hard before early-spring bud break, hydrangeas pruned from late August to September).
map.区分当年新枝开花与老枝开花的植物，确定修剪窗口。: Distinguishes plants that flower on new wood from those that flower on old wood, to determine the pruning window.
map.：按季节给出 best（最适宜）/ok（可以）/avoid（避免）三档。典型时机: Each season is rated best (most suitable) / ok (acceptable) / avoid. Typical timings: roses pruned hard before early-spring bud break and deadheaded after flowering to encourage a second flush; osmanthus pruned in the dormant winter season and avoided in summer; crape myrtle pruned hard in winter on one-year-old wood and spring-pinched; hydrangeas pruned from late August to September (old-wood types immediately after flowering); camellias pruned in spring after flowering and not in the autumn bud-differentiation period; bougainvillea pruned and shaped at the end of winter and start of spring; pomegranate pruned before early-spring bud break; grape pruned during the winter dormant season.
map.：查询“绣球花”：春 avoid、夏 ok、秋 best、冬 ok，最佳修剪期为: Query "hydrangea": spring avoid, summer ok, autumn best, winter ok, with the best pruning period in late August to September because it flowers on old wood, and a hard spring prune would cut formed buds and cost the year its flowers. Query "rose": spring and autumn best, winter and summer ok, and it can be pruned repeatedly.
map.为什么有些植物秋季不能剪？: Why Can't Some Plants Be Pruned in Autumn?
map.茶花等秋季正处于花芽分化期，此时修剪会直接剪除来年花芽；应等花谢后的春季再整形。: Camellias are entering flower-bud differentiation in autumn, and pruning then would cut off next year's buds directly, so wait until spring after flowering to shape them.
map.best 和 ok 怎么选？: How Do I Choose Between Best and OK?
map.best 表示该季节修剪最有利于开花或恢复；ok 表示可以轻剪或整形但效果一般；: Best means pruning in that season is most favorable to flowering or recovery; OK means light pruning or shaping works but the effect is average; avoid means pruning would clearly affect flowering or overwintering, so it is best avoided.
